_about: Site settings for the synthetic site FDS-01. Everything in this folder is invented for the Evidenceline concept.
name: Fictional Depot Site
synthetic: Synthetic data for a fictional site (FDS-01). Every result, name, date and address in these files is invented for the Evidenceline concept.
soil_scenario: The synthetic scenario states the proposed use as residential with garden, so soil results are compared with HIL A values. Which land use applies is the scientist's call.
water_scenario: Groundwater is compared with drinking-water values only, the only water values loaded. Whether drinking water is the right yardstick for this groundwater is a site-specific call for the scientist.
